jobs.objective: Implement RFC 0168 P0 from origin main and close the final v2 review blockers. Use the canceled v2 branch, head 24d85e5f, only as reference material; do not blindly replay or cherry-pick rejected code without closing every blocker in docs/operator/workflows/rfc-0168-build-v3/context/v1_FINAL_V2_FINDINGS.md. Preserve accepted v2 pieces where correct: RFC 0171 schema and docket work remain intact; RFC 0168 runtime migration numbering must start after the current main frontier, expected 0047 after rechecking; owner bundle 0023 remains the expected free slot after rechecking; MCP bearer material stays under supervisor scratch; absolute provider credential directory guards remain covered; AGY_HOME and FIXTURE_CONFIG_DIR remain positive controls; and the selected run-as uid has explicit access to job worktrees and workspaces. This v3 build must close three gates. Gate 1: UID return must be proof-gated by complete S1-S3 and P1-P5 checks. The lease uid must not return when proof is incomplete. S1 kill failure must fail closed or quarantine instead of being recorded and ignored. S2 must prove provider credential-store absence after cleanup. S3 must prove tmux socket, HOME and reseal-token cleanup, per-lease ACL cleanup, and worktree cleanup before return. P4 and P5 must be real proofs, not deferred or unconditional placeholders. Recovery must expose an operator retry path from quarantined or stuck states that reruns P1-P5 and returns only after clean proof. Gate 2: generation freshness must be enforced for supervise.report. The helper report path must compare the live lane uid generation against lane_uid_leases before heartbeat or terminal metadata updates. Add stale-generation negative tests for helper reports, not only attestation overlay or active control lookup. Gate 3: relative provider credential selectors must resolve against the lane launch cwd or repo root and fail closed when they point inside the target repository. Cover CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR=docs/.lane-auth/secure and ANTHROPIC_CONFIG_DIR=docs/.lane-auth/anthropic, and keep ordinary relative non-credential env allowed where appropriate. Keep the D272 discriminator: fail closed only for provider-owned credential selectors while preserving typed lane_uncovered_credential_selector_inside_repo for uncovered provider credential directory selectors resolving in-repo. Update docs that move with the implementation, including RFC 0168 status, roadmap row 2b, operator brief, README, CHANGELOG, or reference docs if source behavior changes, and the command-authority matrix if any RPC or route authority changes. Do not add a new decision unless implementation reopens the D272 security boundary. Run cd go && go build ./... && go vet ./...; run targeted tests for touched packages plus go test ./..., make check-docs, make lint, make typecheck, and smoke when feasible. Publish DRAFT.md summarizing files changed, how each final v2 blocker is closed, tests run, and any residual operator work.
